title: HR Administrator
company: ACS Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR ADMINISTRATOR

Northampton Up to £30,000 Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:30pm Permanent

An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced HR Administrator to join a well-established and globally recognised business in Northampton.

Working as part of a supportive HR team, this role will play an important part in keeping the employee lifecycle, HR systems and day-to-day people processes running smoothly.

What will you be doing?
- Supporting the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding through to leavers
- Maintaining accurate and confidential employee records and HR systems
- Preparing contracts, offer letters and HR documentation
- Coordinating right-to-work checks and new starter paperwork
- Supporting the monthly payroll process
- Managing HR inbox queries and supporting employees and managers
- Maintaining absence, holiday and training records
- Producing HR reports and supporting HR projects and audits
- Helping identify opportunities to improve HR processes

What are they looking for?

The ideal candidate will have:

-Previous experience in HR Administration, HR Assistant or a similar role
-Excellent organisation and attention to detail
-Confidence handling confidential and sensitive information
-Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook
-Strong communication and people skills
-The ability to juggle multiple priorities in a busy environment
-Experience using HR systems would be advantageous
-CIPD Level 3 or working towards it would be a bonus

What's on offer?

-Up to £30,000 per annum
-25 days annual leave + 8 bank holidays
-Free on-site parking
-Company pension
-Life Assurance
-Employee Assistance Programme
-Employee discounts
-Cycle to Work scheme
-Training and development opportunities
-Long service awards & referral rewards

Interested? Apply today to discuss confidentially with Gabriella Saunders at ACS Staffing Solutions!

title: HR Administrator
company: ENB Recruitment and Training Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Administrator

Northampton

£30k per annum

Monday-Friday 08:30-17:30

ENB are supporting a client in Northampton who are looking for a HR Administrator to join their HR team on a full time, permanent basis. Within this role, you will provide HR administration support to the wider HR team, ensuring employee records, HR processes, and people related documentation are maintained to a high standard while delivering an excellent service to managers and employees across the business.

Day to day you will:
- Support with administrative duties across the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, employment changes and leavers.
- Maintain employee records and HR systems, ensuring all information is accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with GDPR requirements.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, amendments, and other HR documentation in a timely manner.
- Coordinate the onboarding process for new starters, ensuring all required documentation and right-to-work checks are completed.
- Support the payroll process by collating and submitting employee data, including starters, leavers, and contractual changes.
- Manage HR inbox enquiries, responding to routine queries and escalating where appropriate.
- Monitor and maintain absence records, annual leave records, and other employee data.
- Assist with the administration of learning and development activities, maintaining training records and booking courses where required.

What experience will you need?
- Prior experience in an HR Administration or HR Assistant
- A CIPD Level 3 qualification (or currently working towards) would be advantageous.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience maintaining confidential employee information and handling sensitive data appropriately.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships at all levels.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload effectively in a busy environment.
- A proactive and flexible approach, with a willingness to support the wider HR team.
- An understanding of HR processes and employment legislation would be beneficial.
